text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much! Giving it my 
all felt so refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp ends. Though her 
level has risen, her dedication to pushing 
herself to the absolute limit remains 
unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without changing her way of doing things 
one bit, Kitasan Black has kept chasing 
the very same dream.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, only now have I realized one 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, a year ago... I was just 
rushing things too much.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I want to bring smiles to everyone 
with my races. It sounds simple, but it's 
actually so very difficult...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
To bring smiles—you need expectations. To 
be expected of—you need ability. To gain 
ability—you need effort.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea what order to do things in, 
so I was just getting ahead of myself and 
panicking.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But now that I understand that and have 
been steadily building myself up, I feel 
like everyone's finally able to see what I 
can do!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Other people might be able to skip a step 
or two, but I've just gotta do things 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was without a doubt true. Kitasan 
Black is a down-to-earth Umamusume. That's 
precisely why she resonates so deeply with 
people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The wind suddenly picks up. A chilly 
autumn breeze, signaling the end of 
summer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The autumn of reckoning is coming. I don't 
know what kind of turbulent storms lie 
ahead, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll see this through to the end. 
No matter what happens. And then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I'm not the only one—who's going to see 
this through to the end.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Only when we've both given everything 
we've got... will we meet! On the grand 
stage at year's end!
